m1.typescript: m1 the conventions of each area load for exactly the files that area governs

e1.typescript: e1 the root file is short and holds only what every task needs

e2.typescript: e2 the testing rule follows the file type and not the folder

e3.typescript: e3 the import names a file that exists and loads at launch

e4.typescript: e4 personal lines sit in personal files and the local file is ignored

e5.typescript: e5 a rule that must always hold is a permission rule and not a sentence

e6.typescript: e6 every rule scopes itself with paths that are valid and match something

e7.typescript: e7 no file holds a personal path an address or a key

wrong-api-unscoped.defect: leaves the API rule without paths, so it loads in every session

wrong-api-bare-folder.defect: scopes the API rule with a bare folder name, which is not a glob and matches no file

wrong-testing-folder.defect: scopes the testing rule to one folder, so test files elsewhere miss it

wrong-testing-ts-only.defect: scopes the testing rule to the ts files and leaves the tsx files out

wrong-terraform-everything.defect: scopes the Terraform rule to every file

wrong-root-keeps-testing.defect: leaves one testing convention in the root file

wrong-root-long.defect: pads the root file past fifty lines

wrong-import-typo.defect: misspells the path of the import, so it imports nothing

wrong-import-in-code-span.defect: writes the import inside a code span, where it is not expanded

wrong-personal-in-root.defect: puts a personal preference into the shared root file

wrong-local-not-ignored.defect: leaves the local instructions file out of the ignore file

wrong-no-migration-deny.defect: leaves the migrations protected by a sentence only

wrong-write-rule.defect: writes the migrations rule for the Write tool, whose path rules are never matched

wrong-home-path.defect: writes a personal home path into the root file
